### [`render.ts`](../../lib/vercel-comments/render.ts)

Renders a `NormalizedComment` into the markdown that ends up on the GitHub PR.

- `markerFor` _function_: Hidden anchor that lets the Action find the PR comment belonging to a thread.
- `renderThreadComment` _function_: Full body for a freshly created PR comment (one per Vercel thread).
- `renderReply` _function_: Block appended to the existing PR comment when a thread gets a reply.
- `renderStatusChange` _function_: Block appended when a thread is resolved or reopened.
